# Dewey University

> A comprehensive Puerto Rico-based institution offering associate, bachelor's, and master's degree programs in health sciences, nursing, and data science, with multiple campuses and robust online learning capabilities.

Dewey University serves students across Puerto Rico with four physical campuses and extensive online programs. The institution specializes in healthcare education, including nursing, occupational therapy, and speech-language pathology, while also offering professional certifications and continuing education through its comprehensive support infrastructure.

## Key Topics

- Master's Degrees (Maestrías)
- Bachelor's Programs (Bachillerato)
- Associate Degrees (Grados Asociados)
- Family Nurse Practitioner
- Online Programs
- Canvas LMS
- Virtual Library (Biblioteca Virtual)
- Student Services (La Plaza)
- Health Sciences
- Continuing Education & Certifications
- Multiple Campus Locations
- Academic Counseling (Consejería)
- STEM Success Center
- Nursing Simulation Centers
- Data Science in Health

## Academic Programs

- [Master's Degrees (Maestrías)](https://dewey.edu/our-courses/maestrias): Master's degree programs including Family Nurse Practitioner specialization
- [Bachelor's Degrees (Bachillerato)](https://dewey.edu/our-courses/bachillerato): Bachelor's degree programs in health sciences, including speech-language therapy
- [Associate Degrees (Grados Asociados)](https://dewey.edu/our-courses/grados-asociados): Associate degree programs in occupational therapy and health-related fields
- [Online Programs](https://dewey.edu/online): Online degree programs in healthcare, data science, and medical administration
- [Continuing Education & Certifications](https://dewey.edu/ofrecimientos/educacioncontinua): Professional certifications and continuing education programs in healthcare fields
- [University Experience Program](https://dewey.edu/ofrecimientos/experienciauniversitaria): Early college program for high school students with dual enrollment and college credits

## Campus Locations

- [Hato Rey Campus](https://dewey.edu/department/deweyuniversityhatorey): Hato Rey campus with learning resources, nursing simulation, and research centers
- [Carolina Campus](https://dewey.edu/department/deweyuniversitycarolina): Carolina campus featuring STEM Success Center and student support services
- [Juana Díaz University Center](https://dewey.edu/department/deweyuniversityjuanadiaz): Juana Díaz university center with nursing programs and student activities
- [Manatí Campus](https://dewey.edu/department/deweyuniversitymanati): Manatí campus featuring laboratory programs and student community facilities

## Student Support & Services

- [La Plaza - Student Hub](https://dewey.edu/laplaza): Student support hub offering tutoring, mentoring, financial aid, and career services
- [Student Portal](https://dewey.edu/invent-home/estudiantes): Student portal with Canvas LMS, Google integration, and academic resources
- [Academic Counseling (Consejería)](https://dewey.edu/consejeria): Academic and personal counseling services across multiple campus locations

## Learning Resources & Technology

- [Virtual Library (Biblioteca Virtual)](https://biblioteca.dewey.edu): Virtual library with EBSCO database access and academic research tools
- [Canvas & Portfolium Training](https://dewey.edu/canvasyportfolium): Training guides and tutorials for Canvas LMS and Portfolium platforms
